## Migration rules

1. No unknown Replit app may be migrated or deleted until its software identity and dependencies are established.
2. No Replit app is decommissioned merely because source exists in GitHub.
3. `SOURCE_COPIED != MIGRATION_COMPLETE`.
4. Replacement runtime must be built, tested, deployed where required, and functionally verified before cutover.
5. Secret values must not be committed to GitHub.
6. One important software should have one identifiable canonical repository unless an explicit architecture says otherwise.
7. Replit Agent paid/mutating calls are not required for this inventory and are not authorized by this file.

## Current destination map

- Orchestrator → create/use `reis-os-orchestrator` as dedicated canonical repository.
- Hazel Core → retain `hazel-core`; verify whether Replit and GitHub contents are equivalent before any Replit decommission.
- Unknown autogenerated-title apps → remain HOLD; no destination guessed.
